newsitem.title: USA: Clinton's lead dips to 16 points in tracking poll.
newsitem.headline: Clinton's lead dips to 16 points in tracking poll.

text.p: President Bill Clinton's campaign lead over Republican challenger Bob Dole shrank to 16 points in a tracking poll released on Saturday, while Texas billionaire Ross Perot got a slight boost.
Clinton got 51 percent in a CNN/USA Today/Gallup poll of likely voters, compared with 55 percent in Friday's edition of the same poll.
Saturday's poll showed Dole, who had been trailing Clinton by 23 points on Friday, with 35 percent of the vote from those surveyed.
Perot, the Reform Party's presidential candidate, got 7 percent in the Saturday poll, compared with 6 percent the previous day.
The poll had a margin of error of four percentage points.
